verdict.justification: Both deliverables accurately translate the reference input summary into an SOP, a Change Request Form, and a Change Log Tracker, and both thoughtfully identify and address the logical gaps in the source material. However, Deliverable B is considerably more thorough, operational, and ready for real-world deployment in a regulated biotech environment. Deliverable B follows the exact section ordering requested in the reference material (putting Procedure before Change Criteria) and includes a formal "Approval Signatures" block at the top of the SOP so it can actually be "routed for implementation" as requested. Furthermore, Deliverable B fills out the operational details much better, such as providing proposed descriptors for the 1–5 Risk Assessment Scale ("Table 6.3 – Risk Assessment Scale (1–5)"), separating the Fast-Track and Full Review signature tables on the Change Request Form to prevent user error, and including comprehensive usage instructions directly on the Form and Tracker. In contrast, Deliverable A leaves the 1–5 risk scale without descriptors, puts a strange future date ("2026-11-04") in the SOP version history, and provides a much sparser Excel tracker.
